item.title: 💐 Repl Driven Development: /Editor Integrated REPLs for all languages/ 🔁
item.description: Press “C-x C-e” to send any piece of code (in any language) to a REPL in the background, within Emacs!

item.title: 💐 Making VSCode itself a Java REPL 🔁
item.description: VSCode evaluates Java code wherever it sees it, by sending it to a JShell in the background, and echos the results in a friendly way!
